body.h: 1. Relationship to the Statement of Work

body.p: This Change Order amends the Statement of Work it identifies, which it incorporates by reference, and the Agreement and the Statement of Work continue to apply to the work performed under it. It takes effect only when both parties have signed it, before the changed work begins, and it replaces the earlier versions of the sections it changes.

This Change Order describes the work it adds to, changes in and removes from the Statement of Work, in the table above, with the revised completion date and the fees for the change, and the Statement of Work otherwise continues unchanged.

The Statement of Work's completion date is revised to {{revised_completion}}, and its remaining milestone dates move with it. Where Customer requested the change, the timeline is extended by the time the change adds plus reasonable time for Vendor to remobilize. The revised dates bind both parties once this Change Order is signed.

This Change Order states the additional fees for the change, on a fixed-fee or time-and-materials basis, and they are due on completion of the milestone the change affects. It does not reduce the fees for work already begun under the Statement of Work.

This Change Order changes only the provisions of the Statement of Work it expressly identifies, and the rest of the Statement of Work remains in full force and effect. Prior discussions, correspondence and negotiations about this change form part of it only where this Change Order expressly says so.

This Change Order binds the parties once authorized representatives of both have signed it, and electronic signatures are valid. No work under it may begin, and no fees for it accrue, until both parties have signed.

This Change Order is governed by the law that governs the Agreement, any dispute under it is resolved in the manner the Agreement provides, and notices under it are given as the Agreement provides. This Change Order is the entire agreement of the parties on its subject and may be amended only in a writing signed by both parties.
